title: Showset Element List (SEL) as Governed Information

scope.purpose: Define instance-level identification, categorization, and tracking requirements for placed showset and themed-entertainment elements.

requirements.statement: SEL identifiers shall be strictly unique to a single placed family instance within the federated showset model.
Model authors shall not assign duplicate SEL ID codes across different physical showset elements.

provenance.migration_note: SEL demand is governed in S2; shared-parameter binding and carrier structure are implemented through S8/Shared Parameters.
